passages.note: Assembly Floor final-passage vote on SB 32; Gipson voted Aye.
passages.tally_quote: Ayes Count 48 Noes Count 31 NVR Count 1

passages.provision_quote: the state board shall ensure that statewide greenhouse gas emissions are reduced to at least 40 percent below the statewide greenhouse gas emissions limit no later than December 31, 2030.
passages.note: Operative section sets a 40% emissions-reduction limit by 2030, not a clean-energy mandate (H17).

rows.reasoning: Gipson voted Aye on SB 32 (2015-2016)'s Assembly Floor final passage, whose operative section requires the state board to ensure statewide greenhouse gas emissions are reduced to at least 40 percent below the statewide limit by December 31, 2030. Per the rule that a rung's object is a clause (H17), an emissions limit is not itself a mandate for 'a shift to clean energy' since it can be met by means other than clean energy, so it establishes only the pro-action direction, not rung 1.
